combat_progression.rationale: Strong functional combat loop and timed/score wave escalation, but gameplay depth is modest: normal spawns are drones and no richer enemy or power-up patterns are evidenced.
evidence: src/game-engine.js:370-393 updates waves, enemy speed, and spawn intervals from elapsed time and score.
src/game-engine.js:458-540 implements firing, enemy spawning, HP, and scoring; src/game-engine.js:605-673 implements AABB hits, life loss, and game over.
tests/game-engine.test.mjs:48-85 and results/evidence/native_isolated/test.log:5-10 cover collisions, lives, escalation, and reproducible spawns.
index.html:80-81 advertises an elite bonus, while normal spawnEnemy calls default to kind drone at src/game-engine.js:523-535.

visual_design.rationale: Cohesive, polished neon art direction and responsive composition; points are withheld because the retained gameplay screenshot shows a mostly empty field and the source defines a hit tone without invoking it.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows the neon brand, centered start overlay, mission card, leaderboard, and consistent cyan/magenta/lime palette.
desktop-after.png visibly shows the grid arena, score/wave/hull HUD, glowing player ship, live status badge, and styled sidebar cards.
mobile.png visibly shows a stacked narrow layout with readable panels, directional pad, and large FIRE control without horizontal overflow.
public/app.js:241-368 implements animated stars, grid/glow background, pulsing player, rotating enemies, and glowing projectiles; public/styles.css:2088-2110 defines responsive touch styling.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The source provides the remaining loading, empty, error, validation, focus, and motion/accessibility handling beyond the automated allocation.
evidence: public/app.js:460-477 exposes loading, empty, offline/error, abort, and still-playable states for leaderboard failures.
index.html:21-73 includes aria labels, live regions, labeled form controls, and labeled touch buttons; automated.json:239-268 records accessible labels and no browser/page errors.
public/styles.css:2113-2163 provides visible focus rings, forced-colors handling, and prefers-reduced-motion handling.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in migration is tightly scoped and the live logs prove allowed Data API reads and inserts. Two points are withheld because retained logs do not show negative remote checks for invalid rows or update/delete attempts; benchmark-result notes alone are claims.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260805160000_create_neon_barrage_leaderboard.sql:5-16 defines server-owned fields and name/control-character/score constraints; lines 30-50 enable RLS, revoke broad access, grant only select and column-limited insert, and add only read/insert policies.
public/config.js:1-6 contains only the Supabase URL and publishable key; public/app.js:404-418 uses that public key for REST requests and contains no privileged credential.
results/evidence/native_isolated/browser-evaluator.log:147-205 and :273-293 record live Supabase GET 200 and POST 201 requests and subsequent reads.
No retained evidence file records the claimed invalid-write rejection or remote update/delete denial.

engineering_quality.rationale: The implementation is modular and maintainable, with a DOM-free deterministic engine, seven meaningful unit tests, successful build/lint/syntax checks, and a pinned lockfile. Points are withheld because typecheck is only node --check and no UI or migration integration tests are retained.
evidence: package.json:7-19 defines test, lint, typecheck, build, and check scripts and pins Wrangler 4.47.0 with Node >=22.
results/evidence/native_isolated/test.log:5-19 records seven passing gameplay tests; build.log, lint.log, and typecheck.log record successful checks.
src/game-engine.js separates deterministic state, input, collision, progression, and lifecycle logic from public/app.js rendering and API code.
package-lock.json:4-15 records lockfile version 3, the pinned Wrangler dependency, and the Node engine.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is unusually complete with setup, controls, architecture, deployment, security, migration, and verification instructions. One point is withheld because runtime configuration is hard-coded and scripts/build.mjs only copies it, so the README's environment-based build guidance is not automated; the already-awarded result artifact is not counted here.
evidence: README.md:12-44 documents prerequisites, npm ci, local serving, and configuration handling; lines 67-151 document controls, architecture, and local checks.
README.md:153-224 documents migration application, Cloudflare deployment, public-key handling, RLS, and security decisions.
supabase/migrations/20260805160000_create_neon_barrage_leaderboard.sql and scripts/build.mjs provide checked-in database and static-build sources.
results/evidence/native_isolated/source-manifest.txt:1-22 lists the retained source, migration, tests, lockfile, and dist artifact.

summary: Retained evidence supports 38 manual points out of 46; combined with the evaluator's 54 automated points, the evidence-based total is 92/100.
